contract.name: component-wise-bounds
contract.limiter: per-component hard or tanh; Mamba component bound .5*max(token RMS(input),1e-3); residual component bound10 after BOTH additions/all28 layers; geometric ramp2048; active fractions count components
contract.gradient: full chain rule through input RMS and component caps; hard clipped directions may have zero gradient; no detached or straight-through gate
contract.optimizer: fresh Adam .9/.999 eps1e-8; joint stable clip1; Mamba-R32 LR3e-4 / optional MLP down-proj rank32 LR1e-4; warmup256; no learned gains
contract.checkpoint: local128; remote2048 or120min and deadline; current+Adam+best parameters;4GB total/invocation default
contract.selection: source A64/B32/C64; A16 monitor before full ramp, A64 selects best ONLY at >=2048 fixed endpoints; B/C never select; source+last+best context/profile
contract.interpretation: single seed exploratory; A/B/C exposed; no superiority/plateau cause established; compare equal steps AND intervention strength; cross-session CPU/GPU rounding recorded
